name: test-e2e
description: Use this skill when writing, reviewing, or planning end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress, or when deliberately trying to find browser bugs before one is confirmed. For isolated logic or rendering tests without a browser, use test-unit.
when: When writing end-to-end tests with Playwright or planning a browser bug hunt
do-not-use-when: Testing isolated logic or component rendering that doesn't need a browser — use test-unit instead
Investigating a confirmed bug or failing test after the failure is known — use debugging instead
